provenance.graph_diagonal_proof: With all scalar Casimir graph currents assigned (d,d-1), the HL diagonal sets these currents and positive jets to zero. The potential lies in the square of the basic invariant ideal, so its slice derivatives vanish modulo the restricted invariants. The diagonal ring is therefore the nilcone intersected with the Slodowy slice. Flatness of the restricted adjoint quotient gives the regular sequence of basic Casimirs.
provenance.invariant_square_reason: Every active potential monomial has at least two basic Casimir factors.
provenance.method: Adjoint sl2 branching and the nilcone-slice complete intersection; two exact expansion algorithms

The complete QQ minimal resolution of the full principal slice first-jet ideal gives flavor-singlet beta2=3 at (9,1). No numerical value is prescribed for this Higgsed theory. The reduced presentation after eliminating linear relations gives 1 at the SAME (9,1). The actual matrix slice coordinates give identical full Betti degrees; their Casimir coordinate map has a verified polynomial inverse. The target is unchanged. These values refer to the stated presentations; Schur/Macdonald/HL checks remain independent.

predicted_jump_review.summary: Both potentials have the same reduced gradient Groebner basis after explicitly inverted homogeneous polynomial coordinate maps. The chain rule preserves gradient ideals because each Jacobian determinant is a coefficient-field unit. First-jet prolongation is checked; every higher prolongation is block triangular with the same invertible Jacobian on its diagonal. Thus all finite jets, their graded Hilbert functions and ambient minimal Tor dimensions agree. No coefficient-sensitive rank drop or extra syzygy is present at the fixed physical input relative to this generic family.
